page.notes: The three right-margin notes are printed in small type; "Ballea" (1452) and the note beside 1454 are read with some doubt, and "renovatū" and "ordinib," are copied as printed. The years in the left margin are printed beside the first name of each group; they are kept as cell values in the first line of each group. Horizontal rules between groups are not transcribed.
